source: Disgaea 1 Complete Switch main (selector table 0x7100232d58, 66 characters x 4 lists; VOICEMAP1 inventory.json) for who says which clip in which list; clip audio is read from the Disgaea PC DATA.DAT voice banks (same clip names in all three editions; PC is Ogg Vorbis, the only one ffmpeg decodes). Names, list numbers and hashes only, no audio.

slot_evidence.script_note: 632 voice calls in 3,816 framed script events: list 0 is the general attack / skill shout (509 calls, every event family); lists 1 and 2 are called only inside skill choreographies; list 3 twice.
slot_evidence.recordings_note: D1 clips matched (waveform cross-correlation >= 0.87) to Disgaea RPG clips of the same character, whose cue names label them. List 0: 12 of 15 matched clips are attack or heavy-attack cues. Lists 1 and 2 are skill shouts by the script survey; which D5 skill-shout slot each takes follows the D4 precedent (VOICES2) and the partial recording evidence, a labelled choice. List 3 is not routed.

clip_rule: A clip in list 0/1/2 follows the list. A clip in no routed list that Disgaea RPG names (same recording) follows that cue. Anything else stays silent.

silent_note: Packs whose Disgaea 1 character has no entry (or four empty lists) in the voice selector: the game plays nothing for them, so the pack is linked to a voice id without lines (drpgvoice.SILENT_VOICE_ID).
sound_effect_note: Monsters: all four selector lists hold one audio record of type 1 = a shared sound effect (07_05, 07_09 or 07_10 of sound bank 1; Disgaea PC SUBDATA.DAT -> START.DAT member 66, Ogg). Disgaea 1 plays it where a character would shout, so it is the pack's voice on the same routes; one file serves both dubs. The effect records carry gain 138 where voice records carry 168, so the line volume is scaled by 138/168; it is routed to battle situations only (kind 0).
no_damage_death: Disgaea 1 voices only what its scripts request (opcode 0x87, lists 0-3; 632 calls, all in attack / skill / per-character action events). No list and no clip is a damage or death line (0 of 86 clips shared with Disgaea RPG is named voice_damage; the one voice_dead recording is a skill shout in list 2), so damage and death are silent, as in Disgaea 1.
